# Ring & Respond

> Ring & Respond is Sunny, an AI receptionist for dental offices. Sunny answers the calls a dental office misses — after hours and during overflow — in the practice's name, captures appointment requests (caller name, validated callback number, reason, preferred time), and flags urgent callers as top priority on the team's callback list. She answers in English, Spanish, Arabic, and Farsi. Sunny does not book appointments directly; the office confirms every request. She does not diagnose or give medical advice.

## Plans

- After-Hours Capture: $199/month
- 24/7 Complete: $299/month
- Extra locations: 20% off per additional location
- $0 setup (done-for-you setup included)
- Paid 30-day pilot: first month up front, unconditional money-back guarantee, go-live in 5 days or less, capture report around day 25
- Month-to-month, no contract, no exit fee
